youtube_description:
Why can polyester hold on to body odour? It's not just about brand or quality — polyester fibre is oleophilic, meaning it has a strong affinity for oils. Body oils and soil cling to it, which can lead to soiling and odour retention. Polyester is also inert, so it isn't easily modified — that's why a soil-release finish is used. Before you order polyester or poly-blend T-shirts, ask your supplier whether the fabric has a soil-release finish applied.
